'''Jom Irimore''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Irimore was stationed in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Irimore was approached by an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] officer who was willing to defect to the Rebellion. The Imperial officer was eager to defect and give sensitive information to the Rebels because he had lost his family during the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].<ref name="P14.1" /> Jom Irimore thus recruited a Rebel operative to escort the Imperial defector to Rebel Officer [[Teslo Ten'Doora]] at the [[Hidden Rebel Base]] on Corellia. However, the defector eventually changed the plans and requested the Rebel operative to deliver a codephrase to Ten'Doora: "Droids need Star Destroyers in the evening." The operative delivered successfully the correct codephrase.<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateRebelOfficerQuestGiver.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Jom Irimore]]
Jom Irimore was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jom Irimore was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />

Since Jom Irimore spawned under the generic "rebel_officer_questgiver" template, their appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:BIttRB" />
